role: Retrospective numerical audit, registered after original case/score inspection and independent objective diagnosis, before repaired bootstrap and prediction scoring; not original prespecification
repair_rule: Use independently obtained same-objective residual-contrast profile optimum, verify unchanged original KKT certificate. Re-evaluate original prediction algebra at that fixed optimum, rerun original B100 bootstrap with identical seeds and unmodified bootstrap optimizer/95percent rule. No tuning by accuracy.
prediction_scoring: Seal every repaired prediction and status before any repaired truth scoring. Compare all256 original populations with only these two reference predictions replaced; retain all cases, original proposed mixture, ICC, fullSAR, weights and Holm families. Leave-two-out is diagnostic only, never primary.
additional_discovery: Audit success-flag-true but KKT-false central fits as a separate numerical concern. Do not claim global article robustness from the two-case repair if this broader concern is material.
